verdict.rationale: An email service could plausibly offer in-product AI insights and suggestions, so this axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents no AI-generated insights or suggestions feature. It covers only search, filters, templates, snooze, spam filtering and the JMAP API, none of which is AI-generated insight.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
